messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: reserved-capacity pool rsvd-eu-04 hitting 100% GPU utilization for >5m. Multiple enterprise tenants (acct: GreenfieldPay, Brightleaf) reporting queued requests and 429s. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit quota/cap limits. Severity: P1. Pager: maya (oncall).

maya (oncall): I'm on it. seeing queue length spike in rsvd-eu-04. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/obs/pools/rsvd-eu-04 (errors + CPU/GPU %). Anyone on-call for dedicated autoscaler?

trent (sre): pinging infra. initial read: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts -> API quota error 403: "quota exceeded" from cloud provider. Also a pattern of many long-running sessions from GreenfieldPay.

li (infra): confirming. cloud quotas for project rw-prod-eu reached GPU count limit; autoscaler requested new nodes but API blocked because org limit hit. Creating ticket with cloud ops. We can temporarily burst to coldpool if allowed, but need manual approval.

maya (oncall): triage path: 1) mitigate customer impact (rate-limit / temporary tenancy fallback) 2) free up immediate capacity (evict low-priority sessions) 3) escalate quota to cloud ops. Ideas?

trent (sre): For (2) we can run eviction on low-priority reservation groups: rwdctl pool evict --pool rsvd-eu-04 --priority low --dry-run to show candidates. If approved, perform actual evict to free GPUs. This will affect a handful of non-enterprise dev reservations.

li (infra): run dry-run and paste candidates.

deploy-bot: Deploy log: autoscaler-v2 attempted scale at 2024-08-21T03:12:11Z -> 3 failed attempts; last error: quotaExceeded.

trent (sre): dry-run output:
```
Candidates to evict (10 sessions)
- dev-session-112 (batch) 
- ci-run-77 (short)
- ondemand-temp-51 (low-priority)
Total GPUs reclaimable: 2
```

maya (oncall): Good. Recommend immediate evict of those 10 sessions to get ~2 GPUs. Also start per-tenant throttles for GreenfieldPay and Brightleaf to reduce queue growth while we free capacity. Who can apply throttles?

li (infra): I can add a temporary routing rule to divert new sessions from those tenants to a best-effort shared pool (shared-eu-02) and apply tenant-level rate limits. Doing: rwdctl routes add --src-tenant greenfieldpay --to-pool shared-eu-02 --policy best-effort --ttl 30m

li (infra): applied. Also creating rate-limit: rwdctl quota update --tenant greenfieldpay --qps 8 --ttl 30m. Repeat for brightleaf with qps 6.

zoe (acct-exec): Opening a customer bridge and pinging GreenfieldPay SM/engineering. On bridge: +1 for transparency.

maya (oncall): After evict, monitor queue and token failure rate. Trent, perform eviction now if you confirm low-priority only.

trent (sre): running eviction: rwdctl pool evict --pool rsvd-eu-04 --sessions dev-session-112,ci-run-77,ondemand-temp-51 --confirm

trent (sre): Eviction complete, reclaimed 2 GPUs. Queue length reduced by ~12% on graph. Latency for enterprise requests still elevated but 429s dropped 40%.

maya (oncall): Good delta. Still seeing sustained higher-than-normal session lengths from GreenfieldPay. We should gate heavy long-lived sessions -> suggest temp policy to cap live-session runtime to 20m for that tenant.

li (infra): Adding policy: rwdctl tenant update --tenant greenfieldpay --max-session-seconds 1200 --reason "incident mitigation" --ttl 45m

trent (sre): Noted. Also observed autoscaler backoff logic is not bubbling quotaExceeded to oncall alerts properly. Filing follow-up bug: autoscaler should fallback to tiered offload (spill to shared pool) when quota blocked.

maya (oncall): Oncall notes: customer impact: GreenfieldPay experiencing elevated 500/429 surface; Brightleaf intermittent timeouts. Mitigation status: throttles + routing diversion + 2 GPUs reclaimed via eviction + session cap applied. Action items: 1) li escalate cloud GPU quota increase (blocked) 2) triage autoscaler fallback bug (trent) 3) account bridge + customer comms (zoe) 4) follow-up post-incident RCA (maya).

li (infra): Cloud quota request opened: ticket #CLOUD-2341 -> requested +16 GPUs in eu-west region. ETA quoted 3-6 hours unless expedited. Trying phone route.

zoe (acct-exec): On customer bridge, GreenfieldPay asked for ETA and offered to shift some heavy workloads to off-peak. Shared workaround: reduce batch sizes and retry with exponential backoff. I'll coordinate ops for an agreed ramp down.

trent (sre): Additional short-term improvement: enable prefix KV caching for GreenfieldPay to reduce per-request token work. Can toggle via config: rwdctl config set --tenant greenfieldpay --kv-cache enabled=true --ttl 60m. Want to flip?

maya (oncall): Do it. Lower risk. Trent, apply and monitor.

trent (sre): Done. Initial telemetry shows per-request GPU time down ~8%. Queue backlog decreasing slowly.

deploy-bot: Note: new autoscaler patch landed on canary earlier today (autoscaler-v2.1) but not rolled to prod pools due to canary flags. Might consider emergency rollout if safe.

li (infra): Given quota, rolling autoscaler won't add physical capacity but could change fallback behavior. Might help future similar incidents. I suggest patch to add fallback to shared pool on scale error as a quick fix.

maya (oncall): Do we have permission to force a targeted config change to rsvd-eu-04 to enable fallback? If so, implement and monitor for side effects.

trent (sre): I can patch routing rule on the pool to enable 'fallback_on_scale_fail=true' for 1h: rwdctl pool update --pool rsvd-eu-04 --set fallback_on_scale_fail=true --ttl 1h. Applying now.

trent (sre): Patch applied. Observed immediate small spillover to shared-eu-02. Error rate trending down.

maya (oncall): Standby for cloud quota response. If they approve quick GPU increase we'll drain some workloads back. For now keep throttles and routing in place.

li (infra): Cloud support called. They can expedite to 1h but require justification email. I'll send escalation with customer impact and contacting sales.

zoe (acct-exec): Providing customer impact note to Cloud support and looping sales for expedite. Also sending GreenfieldPay interim status update.

maya (oncall): Summary for this thread: root cause: reserved pool rsvd-eu-04 saturated; autoscaler failed to add capacity due to cloud GPU quota; exacerbated by a set of long-lived high-consumption sessions from GreenfieldPay. Immediate mitigations: manual low-priority eviction (2 GPUs), tenant-level throttles/reroute to shared pool, session cap, KV cache toggle, enable pool fallback. Customer comms initiated. Next steps: escalate quota (li), autoscaler fallback bugfix (trent), post-incident RCA and possible policy for reserved pool headroom (maya/eng)

trent (sre): Filing incident ticket IR-2024-4567 with logs and timeline. Will include playbook edits for reserved pool saturation and fallback automation.

li (infra): Cloud support replied: provisional +8 GPUs available within 55m; will confirm.

maya (oncall): Thanks all. I'll keep this thread open until quota confirmed and queues are stable for 30m. If anyone has urgent findings DM me.

zoe (acct-exec): Bridge closed for now; customers looped. Will reopen if they report regressions.

incident-bot: Incident note saved: IR-2024-4567. Handing off to oncall for post-incident actions.
